business_summary: Zhejiang Tenchen Controls Co., Ltd., together with its subsidiaries, engages in the research, development, production, sale, and service of automobile seats in China, the United Kingdom, Thailand, and internationally. The company offers construction machinery seats for excavators, shovel hauler, industrial vehicles, off-highway mining, and agricultural machinery; commercial vehicle seats for heavy and light trucks, buses, and trains; passenger car seats; aircraft seats; child safety seats; frames and mechanism products comprising frames, sliders, recliners, and height adjusters; foam and seat covers; and lightweight products, such as carbon fiber and aluminum alloy products. It exports its products. Zhejiang Tenchen Controls Co., Ltd. was founded in 1984 and is headquartered in Tiantai, China.
